non-blocking: stale_group reports a legacy-only group but nothing removes it — write() delegates to store_overwrite(), whose delete_group only ever deletes self.group, so re-ingesting a cache written under the pre-convention key leaves the legacy group on disk beside the new one permanently, duplicating every such group with no path to reclaim it, and once the new group exists stale_group returns None so the orphan never surfaces again.
